title: confiture migrate squash --format json
description: The migrations `migrate squash` replaced with one baseline, and the baseline. With --dry-run nothing is written and the payload says what would be. A refusal (VALID_006, VALID_007) or a failed replay writes the error envelope (error-envelope.schema.json) instead.

environments.description: Each db/environments/*.yaml the squash asked first, by file name; `skipped` when db/project.yaml lists it in squash.skip_environments.

through.description: The --through version: the last one squashed.

baseline.description: The baseline's .up.sql path; its .down.sql, which refuses, sits beside it.

version.description: The baseline's version: the one after --through, or --version.

source.description: `replay`: the schema dumped from a scratch database the squashed migrations built. `build` (--from-build): the tree, proven by a drift check to be that schema.

digest.description: SHA-256 of the squashed versions and their checksums, carried in the baseline's header; `migrate up` compares it with each database's ledger.

archived.description: Every file of the squashed versions (.py, .up.sql, .down.sql, .verify.sql): moved to <migrations-dir>/archive/, or deleted with --delete.

dry_run.description: True with --dry-run: nothing was written or moved.

ok.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command produced this report. A command that could not produce one writes the error envelope, where ok is false.

command.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command that wrote this payload, as typed after `confiture`.
